outcome: Maternal outcomes (hysterectomy, ICU admission, hospital stay)
Neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, NICU admission, neonatal death)
cohort: 51 women who experienced uterine rupture during labor and delivery at KAUH between January 2011 and December 2015.
finding: The incidence of uterine rupture was 0.03%, with scarred uterus rupturing more frequently than unscarred uterus, and risk factors included age > 35 years, gravidity > 4, past history of C/S, level of education less than 12 years, and significant neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a variable, but no specific information provided
